Subject: Quick: options for extending our 30d eval?

Hey Diego,

Thanks again for the run last week — the team has been iterating on prompts and we pushed a small integration to staging. We burned through more tokens than expected during stress testing and our PO wants to understand options so we don't lose momentum. Two asks: 

1) Can we get a 2-week extension on the current time-boxed eval (same model and capacity)?
2) If we need a short extension beyond that, what does a cost-neutral option look like (credits vs. time; potential small discount)?

I attached our usage export from the sandbox so you can see the burst pattern.

Attachments: clariti_eval_usage.csv (csv)

Appreciate a crisp list of scenarios (short table or bullets) — we need to loop procurement if there are any charges. Adding Dana from procurement on my side if we need paperwork.

—Marty
Marty Chen
Head of Integrations, Clariti AI
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Marty Chen <marty@clariti.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: options for extending our 30d eval?

Marty — thanks for the usage file. Saw the burst pattern around the inference stress tests; makes sense why you ran through the allotment. High level options below (I attached a concise scenario matrix): pricing_scenario_matrix.xlsx (excel).

Short extension (no cost)
- 14 additional days, same capacity, no additional charge. Limited to one no-cost extension per account. Ideal if you need another quick QA run.

Credit-only bridge (cost-neutral over time)
- Add a 50k token credit pool that covers expected burst (we estimate ~48k tokens based on your export).
- If you convert to a 3-month committed pilot within 30 days, we can refund up to 75% of the credit as a credit against the committed term.

Discounted short-term topup (paid)
- 2-week topup with a 20% discount on per-token rate for the topup volume. Upfront invoice required.

Surge-cap guardrail (risk mitigation)
- Configure a surge cap to avoid unexpected token burn and enable automatic graceful throttling; add a $0 support response SLA (optional) for production-like tests.

Docs & next steps
- Attached: pricing_scenario_matrix.xlsx (contains per-scenario numbers and monthly run-rate projections) and a draft extension term sheet: redwood_extension_terms_draft.docx (word).
- If you want finance to sign, we can generate a short addendum and route via DocuSign; HubSpot deal id: CLAR-2026-00123.

Question for you: is Clariti open to a short committed pilot (30d->90d) at a modest discount in exchange for a partial credit rebate? That is typically the lowest friction path to go from evaluation to pilot.

If you want, Kimberly can own the contract side and Priyom can run the final numbers for a conversion.

Next steps: tell me which scenario you prefer and whether procurement wants a PO or DocuSign.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
